source: WiLLstudio Ordering Matrix & Part Numbers (Tyler, 2026-08-03) — decoded from the WiLLstudio decorative-arms ordering sheet
provenance: Transcribed from the ordering-matrix reference note (the arms sheet Tyler supplied on 2026-08-03) — the ONLY hand-transcribed ordering data in the repo. Fixture + decorative-pole numbers are built from the machine-parsed spec sheets instead (docs/spec-options.json). Parts with neither source resolve to no part number rather than a fabricated one.
finishCodeNote: BK/WH/NA are exact; DB (Dark Bronze) and DG (Dark Green) are the inferred nearest matches already flagged in docs/spec-options.md — confirm with Tyler/Cole alongside catalog.finishesProvisional.
socketOdNote: Nominal OD (inches) of the host socket an arm slips over — drives the Pole/Tenon Fit segment. Sockets absent from this map (nafco-tenon, sport-pole-top, pendant, arm-mount) have no published fit vocabulary, so the fit segment stays unresolved instead of guessed.
fitToleranceNote: A derived OD must land within this many inches of a code's nominal OD, else the fit segment stays unresolved. 'hostPoleShaftOd' reads the host pole's shaft OD from its placeholder radiusTopM (the shaft above the decorative base flare), so a 4" nominal shaft resolves to the 4" fit code.

armOptions.label: Center Shepherds Hook Brand/Logo/City Round Feature

armOptionsNote: The arms sheet's Options column. These append to the part number (CF = Custom is omitted here — a custom feature is a quote conversation, not a code the configurator can assemble).

arm-upsweep-no-gusset.label: Upsweep Arm (No Gusset)
arm-upsweep-no-gusset.note: ASSUMPTION TO CONFIRM: the curated 'Decorative Upsweep' wizard arm is mapped to the sheet's Upsweep Arm (No Gusset) BR family; the HSX catalog product takes the Deco Upsweep HS codes. Second digit = arm count, third = arm length.

unmapped.note: Products with no supplied ordering matrix resolve to NO part number (surfaced as 'ordering matrix pending'), never a guessed one.
families: Wall Mount (WM1/WM2) and Pendant Ceiling Mount (PC1-3) — on the sheet, but no catalog part exists yet
WiLLstudio decorative bullhorn brackets — a catalog product, not on the supplied arms sheet
All NAFCO and WiLLsport arms/poles/fixtures — separate brand matrices, not yet supplied
Curated fluted/round base covers — style codes not on the supplied sheet

aluminum-light-pole-base-covers (dropship 'Aluminum Light Pole Base Covers' product) — this hand-transcribed matrix originally assigned it CL2 ('Two-piece aluminum base cover'), but the machine-parsed 8/4 spec sheet (docs/spec-options.json) and the real-CAD ingest (docs/real-geometry.json) both confirm CL2 = Medium Clamshell = catalog part bc-cl2-medium-clamshell, a DIFFERENT part. The CL2 assignment here was a transcription error and has been removed rather than guessed at; this part's real design code (if it has one) is unconfirmed — see docs/part-numbers.md.

fitEvidenceNote: Engineering's released CAD names every WiLLstudio arm with a FLUSH pole fit (SH1-40F, SS1-40F..SS4-40F, AR1-40F..AR4-40F) and the released pole is a 4" OD straight (RSAA-4040-12), so the arm families resolve their fit from the host pole's shaft OD against the flush-fit table: a 4" pole gives 40F. The catalog's `tenon-3in` socket type is Phase-0 placeholder vocabulary, not an ordering code; the tenon fit table stays for arms that really are tenon-mounted. See docs/real-geometry.json for the file-level provenance.
